quotes.text: Anderson is regarded as one of country music's most significant performers.
For her work as a crossover artist, she was ranked on Rolling Stone's list of the "100 Greatest Country Artists of All Time" and CMTs "40 Greatest Women of Country Music".
This included 1969's Songs That Made Country Girls Famous, which was a tribute to female country artists.
In 1992 with the western album, Cowboy's Sweetheart.
Her 2005 studio release, The Bluegrass Sessions, was nominated for Best Bluegrass Album at the Grammy Awards.
Shortly before her death in 2015, Anderson released the gospel project, Bridges.
